institutions.name: Sundance Film Festival
institutions.description: An independent film festival in January with dramatic, documentary, short and episodic programs.

institutions.name: Berlin International Film Festival
institutions.description: A February festival with a main competition, a panorama of audience favorites and short films.

institutions.name: Cannes Film Festival
institutions.description: A May festival with a main competition, out-of-competition screenings and a short film competition.

institutions.name: Annecy International Animation Film Festival
institutions.description: A June festival dedicated to animation, with feature, short and television competitions.

institutions.name: Venice International Film Festival
institutions.description: A late-summer festival with a main competition and an out-of-competition program.

institutions.name: Toronto International Film Festival
institutions.description: A September festival whose audience award is decided by festival audiences.

institutions.name: San Sebastián International Film Festival
institutions.description: A September festival in the Basque Country with an official competition.

institutions.name: Busan International Film Festival
institutions.description: An autumn festival with a competition and a large program of new work.

institutions.name: Sitges Film Festival
institutions.description: An October festival of fantastic and horror cinema.

institutions.name: International Documentary Film Festival Amsterdam
institutions.description: A November documentary festival with feature and short competitions.

institutions.name: Hot Docs Canadian International Documentary Festival
institutions.description: An April documentary festival with an audience award.

institutions.name: Clermont-Ferrand International Short Film Festival
institutions.description: A short film festival in late January and early February.

institutions.name: SXSW Film & TV Festival
institutions.description: A March festival with narrative, documentary, short and episodic programs and audience awards.

institutions.name: Series Mania
institutions.description: A March festival for television series.

institutions.name: Locarno Film Festival
institutions.description: An August festival with an international competition and a large open-air audience.

institutions.name: FESPACO
institutions.description: The Pan-African film and television festival, held every two years in Ouagadougou. In this game, entries need an African production base.

institutions.name: Academy Awards
institutions.description: Annual film awards voted by Academy members. In this game, features need a theatrical release in the United States during the eligibility year; shorts need a festival award or a US theatrical release.

categories.name: Best Actor In A Leading Role
Best Actress In A Leading Role
Best Actor In A Supporting Role
Best Actress In A Supporting Role

institutions.name: BAFTA Film Awards
institutions.description: Annual film awards. In this game, entries need a UK theatrical release during the eligibility year.

institutions.name: BAFTA Television Awards
institutions.description: Annual television awards. In this game, entries need a UK broadcast or streaming release during the eligibility year.

institutions.name: Golden Globe Awards
institutions.description: Annual film and television awards. Film comedy and musical work competes separately from drama.

categories.name: Best Motion Picture, Musical Or Comedy
Best Television Series, Musical Or Comedy

institutions.name: Primetime Emmy Awards
institutions.description: Annual US television awards. In this game, entries need a US broadcast or streaming release between June 1 and May 31.

categories.name: Outstanding Directing For A Drama Series
Outstanding Writing For A Drama Series
Outstanding Lead Actor In A Drama Series
Outstanding Lead Actress In A Drama Series
Outstanding Directing For A Comedy Series
Outstanding Writing For A Comedy Series
Outstanding Lead Actor In A Comedy Series
Outstanding Lead Actress In A Comedy Series

institutions.name: International Emmy Awards
institutions.description: Annual awards for television made outside the United States. In this game, entries need a production base outside the US and a broadcast or streaming release.

institutions.name: Annie Awards
institutions.description: Annual animation awards with feature, short, television and individual achievement categories.

categories.name: Voice Acting In A Feature Production

institutions.name: Film Independent Spirit Awards
institutions.description: Annual awards for independent film and television. Performance categories are gender-neutral. In this game, commissioned projects are not eligible.

institutions.name: Gotham Awards
institutions.description: Annual awards for independent film. Performance categories are gender-neutral. Series awards moved to separate television awards in 2024.

institutions.name: Directors Guild Of America Awards
institutions.description: Annual awards for directing in film, documentary and television.

institutions.name: Writers Guild Awards
institutions.description: Annual awards for screen and television writing.

institutions.name: Producers Guild Awards
institutions.description: Annual awards for producing in film and television.

institutions.name: Actor Awards
institutions.description: Annual awards for screen performers, voted by performers.

categories.name: Male Actor In A Leading Role
Female Actor In A Leading Role

institutions.name: César Awards
institutions.description: Annual French film awards. In this game, entries need a French production base and a theatrical release in France.

institutions.name: Goya Awards
institutions.description: Annual Spanish film awards. In this game, entries need a Spanish production base and a theatrical release in Spain.

institutions.name: Canadian Screen Awards
institutions.description: Annual Canadian film and television awards. In this game, entries need a Canadian production base.

institutions.name: AACTA Awards
institutions.description: Annual Australian screen awards. In this game, entries need an Australian or New Zealand production base and an Australian release.

institutions.name: Africa Movie Academy Awards
institutions.description: Annual awards for African film. In this game, entries need an African production base.

institutions.name: Japan Academy Film Prize
institutions.description: Annual Japanese film awards. In this game, entries need a Japanese production base and a theatrical release in Japan.

institutions.name: Blue Dragon Film Awards
institutions.description: Annual South Korean film awards. In this game, entries need a South Korean production base and a theatrical release in South Korea.

institutions.name: European Film Awards
institutions.description: Annual awards for European film. In this game, entries need a European production base.
